verdict.rationale: Lago's own API reference gives every endpoint a generated command, shows copy-paste curl examples, and publishes an OpenAPI 3.1 schema, so runnable examples are documented. There is no evidence of an interactive explorer such as an in-browser try-it console. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive in-browser playground/try-it console, independent or hands-on corroboration of the reference experience.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Every endpoint in this reference has a generated command.
Use Lago's OpenAPI 3.1 schema to generate clients, inspect typed operations, or expose billing actions to an AI agent.
